thread:
emily: Hey team — new hire hit a 401 following the onboarding sample. Says 'missing api key' when trying the quickstart. Anyone seen this? 

josh: Which quickstart? node or python?

emily: quickstart-js in /examples/onboarding. The README shows process.env.API_KEY but our code expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. Seems like copy/paste drift.

marta: Oh nice catch. We renamed the env var last year but not all examples got updated. Also FYI the JS SDK constructor changed a bit.

samir: I can repro locally. Example file: 
```js
// examples/onboarding/index.js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood-inference/sdk');
const client = new Redwood(process.env.API_KEY); // <- this fails
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```

josh: Oof. That second line is both the wrong class name and the wrong env var.

marta: Suggested fix: 
```js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood-inference/sdk');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, retry: { retries: 2, backoff: 200 } });
const res = await client.text.generate({ prompt: 'hello' });
```
Also update README to call out REDWOOD_API_KEY and show the minimal retry config we recommend for onboarding.

emily: Created PR with the change + README update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/452 — includes a one-line note about token env var standardization and a tiny CI job that runs the example with a stubbed endpoint.

docs-ci-bot: PR 452 opened by emily — checks pending :rocket:

samir: Thx. I added a quick unit that lints for old env var names across repo. Will submit as follow-up.

josh: Can we also check other languages? Python quickstart uses REDWOOD_KEY in one place IIRC. We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY across SDKs.

marta: Agree. I'll add a check to the SDK parity checklist and file a ticket to update python/go/rust samples.

emily: Nice. Also flagged the migration note in the changelog so external customers don't get surprised.

samir: FYI I hit an edge: some customers vendor the examples into repos, so adding a short comment in the snippet about env var name will help.

emily: Good point — PR now includes a one-line inline comment and a short paragraph in README.

docs-ci-bot: CI run succeeded, lint ok. :white_check_mark:

josh: Can we backport to branch v1-beta? Some customers still reference that tag.

marta: Opening follow-up PR to cherry-pick to v1-beta.

emily: Thanks all — this was fast. Let's keep an eye on the parity board to avoid future drift. :heart:
